title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce on Issuing the Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Advantages of Chamber of Commerce Mediation in Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism in the Private Economy Sector
keywords_en: Advantageous promotion of disputes in the private economy sector
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Advantages of Chamber of Commerce Mediation and Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism in the Private Economy

Fa [2019] No. 11

Higher People's Courts and Federations of Industry and Commerce of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and its Federation of Industry and Commerce:

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, use legal means to serve and guarantee the healthy development of the private economy, and build a social governance pattern of joint construction, joint governance, and shared benefits, the Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Advantages of Chamber of Commerce Mediation and Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism in the Private Economy are hereby issued. Please carefully implement them. Local authorities may formulate specific implementation opinions based on actual conditions. Problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.

January 14, 2019

Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Advantages of Chamber of Commerce Mediation and Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism in the Private Economy

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, use legal means to serve and guarantee the healthy development of the private economy, and build a social governance pattern of joint construction, joint governance, and shared benefits, in accordance with the Opinions on Improving the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, the Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Reform and Development of Chambers of Commerce Affiliated to Federations of Industry and Commerce, and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening the Reform of the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism of People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward on giving full play to the advantages of chamber of commerce mediation, strengthening the mediation-litigation interface work, and promoting the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism in the private economy.

1. Fully recognize the important significance of promoting the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism in the private economy. Deeply understand the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the symposium of private enterprises, and give full play to the institutional advantages of chamber of commerce mediation in resolving disputes in the private economy. Improve the functions of chambers of commerce, enhance their service capabilities, and cultivate and develop chamber of commerce mediation organizations with Chinese characteristics; promote and guide private enterprises to operate, manage, and protect rights in accordance with the law, promote equal protection of property rights, and stimulate and promote entrepreneurial spirit; promote the settlement of business disputes by chambers of commerce, and participate collaboratively in social governance; optimize the allocation of judicial resources, create a favorable legal business environment, and provide judicial protection for the healthy development of the private economy.

2. Work objectives. Strengthen the construction of chamber of commerce mediation organizations and mediator teams, improve and perfect chamber of commerce mediation systems and mechanisms, and provide diversified dispute resolution channels for enterprises. Further transform judicial concepts, give full play to the guiding, driving, and guaranteeing role of the judiciary in the resolution of disputes by chambers of commerce, meet the actual needs of private enterprises for diversified, rapid, and effective dispute resolution, and create a favorable legal environment for the innovation and entrepreneurship of private enterprises. Establish and improve a dispute resolution system that organically integrates chamber of commerce mediation mechanisms with litigation procedures, continuously improve the legal service capacity of the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and promote the healthy development of the private economy.

3. Clarify the scope of chamber of commerce mediation. Chamber of commerce mediation mainly focuses on various civil and commercial disputes of private enterprises, including disputes among chamber of commerce members, disputes within member enterprises, disputes between members and related parties in production and operation, disputes between members and other units or persons, and other civil and commercial disputes suitable for chamber of commerce mediation.

4. Strengthen the dispute resolution function of chamber of commerce mediation. The Federation of Industry and Commerce shall strengthen guidance, direction, and service to affiliated chambers of commerce, support chambers of commerce to establish mediation organizations and operate in a standardized manner in accordance with laws, regulations, and relevant procedures, and make mediation an important channel for resolving disputes in the private economy. Support chambers of commerce to establish people's mediation committees to provide basic and public welfare dispute resolution services for enterprises. Support enterprises and chambers of commerce to establish labor dispute mediation organizations to promptly resolve labor disputes and maintain harmony and stability of labor relations. Encourage industry chambers of commerce to give full play to their own advantages and establish specialized industry mediation organizations. Encourage qualified chambers of commerce to establish commercial mediation organizations, giving full play to the important role of commercial mediation organizations in resolving specialized disputes. Commercial mediation organizations established by chambers of commerce shall be filed with the provincial Federation of Industry and Commerce and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.

5. Actively prevent and resolve disputes. Federations of Industry and Commerce at all levels and their affiliated chambers of commerce shall strengthen the construction of legal service platforms (centers), improve the rights protection and assistance mechanism, encourage qualified enterprises to establish legal departments, company lawyers, or hire legal advisers, and form coordinated and linked legal service forces. Through legal publicity, typical cases, and other means, actively investigate, monitor, and provide early warning of disputes among enterprises and industries, and strengthen the governance of disputes at the source. Strengthen industry self-discipline and industry governance, incorporate concepts such as honesty and trustworthiness, fair competition, and win-win cooperation into chamber of commerce charters and enterprise contract clauses, and urge the voluntary performance of effective awards or mediation agreements.

6. Standardize the operation of chamber of commerce mediation organizations. Chamber of commerce mediation organizations shall be established by the Federation of Industry and Commerce or its affiliated chambers of commerce as needed, and shall have a standardized organizational form, fixed office premises and mediation venues, professional mediators, and a sound mediation work system. Chamber of commerce mediation organizations shall admit qualified outstanding entrepreneurs, chamber of commerce personnel, legal advisers, industry experts, lawyers, trade union representatives, and other members of society as mediators. Make public the roster of chamber of commerce mediation organizations and mediators, mediation procedures, and mediation rules. Standardize the management of dispute processes, improve the interface procedures between mediation and litigation, and establish systems for dispute acceptance, mediation, performance, follow-up, as well as file management, information reporting, assessment and evaluation, etc., pay attention to protecting the privacy and trade secrets of the parties, effectively safeguard the rights and interests of both parties, and continuously enhance the standardization and credibility of chamber of commerce mediation. The Legal Rights Protection Service Center of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce shall strengthen its dispute mediation function, promote horizontal connectivity and vertical linkage, and jointly promote the work of chamber of commerce mediation.

7. Improve the mediation-litigation interface mechanism. People's courts shall admit qualified chamber of commerce mediation organizations or mediators into the roster of specially invited mediation organizations or the roster of specially invited mediators. The rosters shall be dynamically updated and maintained, and complete and accurate information on mediation organizations and mediators shall be provided to the parties for their selection. Implement the mechanisms for dispatched mediation and entrusted mediation, strengthen the interface work with chamber of commerce mediation organizations, and explore the establishment of mediation rooms stationed in people's courts. Strengthen the organic integration of litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution methods, and guide parties to give priority to chamber of commerce mediation organizations for dispute resolution.

8. Strengthen judicial guarantees. Mediation agreements reached through mediation are legally binding, and the parties shall perform them in accordance with the agreement. If immediate performance is possible, the mediation organization shall urge the parties to perform immediately. If the parties apply for judicial confirmation, the people's court shall promptly review and legally confirm the validity of the mediation agreement. If a mediation agreement is reached after the people's court has entered the case on the docket and entrusted the chamber of commerce mediation organization for mediation, and the parties apply for the issuance of a mediation document or withdrawal of the lawsuit, the people's court shall legally review and issue a civil mediation document or a ruling. For disputes that fail to be mediated, they shall be legally channeled into litigation procedures to effectively protect the parties' right of action.

9. Establish an information sharing mechanism. People's courts and the Federation of Industry and Commerce shall establish a joint meeting mechanism to strengthen work communication and exchange. Improve information exchange and data sharing, establish work ledgers for relevant information and dispute resolution, and through mining and analyzing data, study and judge the characteristics, patterns, and problems of dispute types, to provide data support for better promoting chamber of commerce mediation and preventing disputes.

10. Strengthen guidance and training. Improve the training mechanism for chamber of commerce mediators, formulate professional ethics standards for mediators, and continuously improve the professional cultivation, legal literacy, professional knowledge, and mediation skills of mediators through mediation training, seminars, trial observations, legal lectures, and other means; strengthen the construction of the mediator team, promote the establishment of a mediator qualification certification and assessment and evaluation mechanism, and improve mediator management.

11. Improve funding guarantees. Actively seek the support of Party committees and governments, include mediation funds as part of legal services in the fiscal budget, and promote the inclusion of chamber of commerce mediation as a social management service in the government's guidance catalog of government-purchased services. Broaden the sources of funding for chamber of commerce mediation, through chamber of commerce membership fees, social donations, grants, or establishment of funds, etc., to improve the level of funding guarantees. Implement the system of specially invited mediation, provide subsidies to mediators participating in dispatched and entrusted mediation through means such as "case-based subsidies," and provide rewards to outstanding chamber of commerce mediation organizations and mediators.

12. Explore innovative development. With the help of the "Online Federation of Industry and Commerce" construction, integrate the mediation resources of the Federation of Industry and Commerce and its affiliated chambers of commerce, establish databases of various mediation organizations and mediators, and information databases for dispute resolution, and build an interconnected, resource-sharing, safe and reliable information system for dispute resolution. Innovatively carry out online dispute resolution, and improve online mediation procedures. Support local Federations of Industry and Commerce at all levels and their affiliated chambers of commerce to participate in the construction of the "Belt and Road" international commercial dispute prevention and resolution mechanism, to provide services and guarantees for private enterprises to go global.

13. Strengthen publicity and guidance. People's courts at all levels, Federations of Industry and Commerce, and their affiliated chambers of commerce shall fully utilize various media means to publicize the advantages of mediation, summarize and promote typical cases and advanced experiences of chamber of commerce mediation, and guide enterprises to prevent risks and rationally protect their rights.

14. Strengthen organizational leadership. People's courts and Federations of Industry and Commerce at all levels shall vigorously support the work of chamber of commerce mediation, regard it as an important measure to ensure the healthy development of the private economy, as an important part of building a diversified pattern of social dispute resolution, grasp the policy spirit in light of local conditions, and implement it effectively. Higher People's Courts and provincial Federations of Industry and Commerce and their affiliated chambers of commerce shall strengthen guidance over the work of chamber of commerce mediation organizations within their jurisdictions, establish and improve communication mechanisms, and report any situations and problems encountered during work to the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce in a timely manner level by level.
